name: Kishla Village
description: Village on Tarkir where Kotis was a farmer.

timeline.summary: Kotis leads a resistance from Kishla, briefly independent from Silumgar until reinforcements push rebels into the jungle.
timeline.quote: the village was briefly independent from Silumgar

citation.text: "Gudul delta", section "Known locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taigam's golden ship arrives at Kishla, pulled by undead sibsig, to collect the town's debt for Sidisi.
timeline.quote: A human Sultai enforcer lowered the gangplank for the leaders to enter the ship and head belowdecks.

citation.text: "Taigam's Scheming" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Taigam humiliates an elder of Kishla, then has a guard take one of his three children.

citation.text: "Taigam's Scheming" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Kotis rallies the villagers into rebellion when Silumgar's forces try to seize the harvest; the rebels briefly gain independence before being driven into the jungle.
timeline.quote: the farmer Kotis , rallied the villagers into a rebellion

timeline.summary: Kotis organizes his village's resistance against Silumgar, earning brief independence; rebels flee to the jungle after a counterattack.
timeline.quote: he organized his village's resistance, earning it brief independence from Silumgar's rule
